_comment: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct LM-half text encoder for Krea 2 — 12-layer hidden-state tapping at (2,5,8,11,14,17,20,23,26,29,32,35). name: qwen3-4b-instruct
description: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct text path (LM half), 4-bit MLX gs32. Krea 2 text encoder (12-layer tap).
